card: Updates draft release note snippets to include pull request numbers and corrects a version reference. It also documents the snippet format in developer notes and adds a Rust linter check requiring all release note snippets to reference their PR number in markdown. This reduces manual overhead when assembling final release notes for releases.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach; additional release note snippets were formatted and updated with PR references.
evidence: "Include the pull request number in the snippet, using `(#12345)` for a bitcoin/bitcoin PR or `(gui#123)` for a bitcoin-core/gui PR." (doc/developer-notes.md)
"Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more)." (PR description)
problem: Release note snippets often omit PR references or contain outdated version numbers, which causes extra manual overhead and tracking issues when assembling final release notes before a release.

risk.why: Only touches documentation files and a developer lint check, with no impact on consensus, node behavior, or binaries.

summary: Adds pull request references and formatting cleanups to draft release note snippets, fixes a version reference from 32.0 to 32.1, and updates developer documentation. It also introduces a lint check in the Rust test runner requiring all release note snippets to reference their PR number.
